_meta.notes: Owned by readyup-hud (plugins/hud, ships next to the core's engine-surface.json). The custom_hud_layout's dialog-variable elements (HUDPanelDialogVariableString_t) carry a vtable, so the plugin builds them with the class's own primary vtable, found through its RTTI typeinfo name (ru_api surface_rtti_vtable, API 1.17). Nothing is hooked or called through it. Everything else the plugin touches is schema (field offsets by name) plus entity_create / entity_spawn / entity_remove.

HUDPanelDialogVariableString_t.note: Element of CCSCustomHudLayoutState::m_vecDialogVariableStrings; the plugin writes this vtable into each element it adds.
